tuning_method: threshold chosen from 10-fold CV out-of-fold predictions on the training set only; applied to the test set exactly once below
recommended_threshold_source: zero-false-negative point on training-set OOF predictions
caveat: This threshold caught all malignant cases in this particular test split (46 cases; exact 95% CI for sensitivity 92.3-100%), but it is set by a single training patient, varies across CV shuffles, and did not give zero misses on the later temporal cohort. It is specific to this dataset and would need to be re-tuned (via the same train-only procedure) on new data, not reused as a fixed clinical cutoff.
